title: The Portions and the Officers' Offering
reflectionText: Moses and Eleazar received the officers' gold and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial. The officers reported that not one man was missing. What do you notice about the numbered portions, the appointed recipients, and the reason the officers gave for their offering?
